milestones.title: M0 — Reproducible foundation
milestones.description: Repository, CI, real-server testing and resolved backend/economy choices.

milestones.title: M1 — Connected artist backing
milestones.description: Authenticated, persistent and transactional artist backing in staging.

milestones.title: M2 — Trusted invite-only beta
milestones.description: Traceable data, verified receipts, safe operations and release QA.

milestones.title: M3 — Daily habit and reputation
milestones.description: Community rotation, badges and decided recurring Credits.

issues.title: Decide the self-hosted database and authentication approach
issues.summary: Choose the smallest maintainable backend for a real beta. Recommendation: PostgreSQL, typed migrations with Drizzle, and Better Auth; validate current compatibility and choose one login method before installation.
acceptance: Record the options, selected versions, owner decision and recurring costs in an ADR.
Choose an invite/sign-in/recovery flow that does not assume paid email or a Spotify account.
Document local/staging/production configuration, migration ownership and secret boundaries.

issues.title: Run isolated browser tests against the actual Next.js server
issues.summary: Existing native Brave testing used the file-preview React build because localhost binding was denied. Add an isolated Playwright browser and CI flow that never drives the founder's personal Brave window.
acceptance: Install pinned test tooling and browser binaries through supported package sources; keep tests/fixtures separate from real user storage.
Test root redirect, direct app routes, invalid-route 404, hydration, search, buy/cancel/settle, receipt persistence and daily demo labeling against an HTTP Next.js production server.
Cover narrow mobile and desktop widths, keyboard navigation, page/console errors and provide traces/screenshots on failure.
Run in hosted CI if local binding remains blocked; record observed run URL/results, not only a configured workflow.

issues.title: Verify repository, Project workflows and collaborator onboarding
issues.summary: Finish repository operations after the first real CI run. The founder wants to add a collaborator with Admin access later; do not invite anyone until their username and timing are supplied.
acceptance: Verify public repo metadata, CI permissions, dependency updates and successful check names; configure main-branch PR protections where the account plan supports them.
Create/link the Project; configure statuses Backlog, Ready, In progress, In review, Blocked, Done and priority/effort/workstream fields.
Verify closed issues move to Done and document Ready selection, labels, milestones and backlog/board views.
Document future collaborator Admin invitation and its security implications; record that no invitation was sent yet.

issues.title: Specify Credit precision, order eligibility and settlement rules
issues.summary: Turn the accepted 1,000-Credit, artist-only, twice-daily queued backing concept into a versioned contract before implementing live balances.
acceptance: Specify integer centi-Credits, position-unit precision, rounding direction, minimum order and any stake limits.
Choose UTC update boundaries, submission cutoff, eligible snapshot time, delayed observations, stale grace, cancellation cutoff and suspended-artist behavior.
Provide worked examples for buy, loss, partial/full sale, cancelled order, delayed update and source correction.
Separate committed-at, executed-at and metric-observed-at timestamps; decide which proves early support.
Leave weekly top-ups disabled and unspecified until D06; no cash/redemption or cross-platform substitution.

issues.title: Verify canonical identities for the 50-artist shortlist
issues.summary: The shortlist and 93 checked Spotify track mappings do not establish verified Spotify artist identities or live listener baselines. Audit the artist catalog independently.
acceptance: Map each artist to a stable internal ID and reviewed Spotify artist ID/profile URL; record reviewer, date and evidence.
Resolve aliases, duplicate names and collaborations without fuzzy auto-merging; separate artist identity from track credits.
Mark uncertain entries discovery-only until identity and valid baseline are available; keep shortlist language editorial.

issues.title: Resolve pending recordings and preserve version provenance
issues.summary: Audit the seven unresolved tracks and retain the original-release policy the founder requested.
acceptance: Resolve or explicitly leave pending All Love!, radar, radar, HATE UR FACE, I Wanna Be Adored, Anytime, One Death and I Start To Kry with evidence.
Keep Dreamflasher at Spotify 75Wgg4LerPD3mVO5hEyUN9 (3:44 original); keep How to Teleport's distinct 4:33 version label.
Test confirmed Spotify, unchecked availability, reviewed Spotify absence, geographic restriction and player failure; only reviewed absence permits SoundCloud.
Record source/release/duration/version metadata; an official upload alone must not assert recording equality.

issues.title: Investigate listener collection access, reliability and cost
issues.summary: Bounded spike for the preferred twice-daily public-number collection. Assess source access and reliability without bypassing technical restrictions; no paid vendor purchase is part of this issue.
acceptance: Record official source-use constraints, collection method, coverage, source update lag, freshness and access decision with dated links.
Test a small representative artist set and record success/failure/provenance without treating missing metrics as zero.
Estimate central requests for 50 artists × 2 updates/day plus retries and caching; no per-user polling.
Compare verified admin import and a priced licensed provider fallback only if automation is unsuitable; record recommendation and release limitations.

issues.title: Add immutable listener snapshots and validation
issues.summary: Persist source-specific observations before any settlement can trust a number.
acceptance: Store artist/provider/metric, count, observed-at, fetched-at, source URL/evidence reference, parser version and validation result.
Reject missing, nonnumeric, nonpositive and implausible/outlier readings into review; duplicate observations are idempotent.
Keep accepted snapshots immutable and corrections linked; distinguish rolling monthly listeners from streams, followers and cross-platform counts.
Test stale timestamps, duplicate fetches, provider mismatch and corrected observations.

issues.title: Implement verified import and the selected listener adapter
issues.summary: Use the approved source from C03 behind an adapter interface. Verified manual admin imports can unblock an invite-only beta while automation remains unresolved.
acceptance: Provide a schema-validated, audited import with source/observation timestamps and reviewer identity.
If automated access is cleared, add bounded timeouts, request limits, caching, parser fixtures and no access-control bypass.
Never overwrite accepted numbers on an error; surface missing/stale/disputed states to admins and backing eligibility.
Run a documented sample import or collection and prove its snapshot provenance; synthetic fixtures never enter live history.

issues.title: Schedule twice-daily collection and durable settlement jobs
issues.summary: Run one shared worker rather than one collector per user. Coordinate via durable database claims before adding a queue service.
acceptance: Use agreed UTC schedule and unique batch/job IDs; restarting or running two workers cannot settle the same order twice.
Allow bounded retries/backoff and manual replay; record job results and lag.
Collect/validate first, then settle only eligible valid snapshots; source failure does not fabricate a new price.
Test overlapping workers, missed interval, crash after commit and recovery without duplicate ledger or receipt events.

issues.title: Build audited catalog admission and artist-request administration
issues.summary: Keep the curated beta manageable and turn local-only suggestions into a real review queue.
acceptance: Members can submit artist/profile suggestions with duplicate suppression and rate limits.
Only admins can admit, edit, suspend or reject artists, review identities and manage playback provenance.
New entries remain unbackable until reviewed identity and baseline meet policy; provide a user-facing status.
Record who changed catalog/eligibility and why; test ordinary members cannot invoke admin actions.

issues.title: Rehearse stale-data and bad-snapshot corrections
issues.summary: Agree and implement incident handling before a live data error changes user positions.
acceptance: Record the correction/freeze/refund policy and user-visible explanation; preserve the original accepted snapshot and settlement audit.
Implement controlled admin suspension and append-only correction events with authorization and reason.
Rehearse outlier import, source outage, mistakenly admitted artist and corrected baseline in staging.
Verify deterministic balances, retained receipt context and no silent retroactive platform/formula replacement.

issues.title: Create PostgreSQL schema, migrations and isolated seed data
issues.summary: Establish the transactional persistence foundation selected in F01.
acceptance: Model users, catalog, snapshots, ledger, reservations, orders, position lots, settlement batches and receipt events with constraints/indexes.
Document money/quantity precision and uniqueness for grants, requests and settlements; use UTC timestamps.
Support clean local setup and migration from empty staging DB; demo seeds are opt-in and clearly tagged.
Keep DB credentials server-only and make schema migrations repeatable without rewriting applied migrations.

issues.title: Implement invite-only sessions and authorization
issues.summary: Add the chosen sign-in flow with ownership enforcement; local storage must never establish identity.
acceptance: Implement sign-in/sign-out, invite admission, session expiry and chosen recovery method with secure cookie/CSRF/origin protections.
Authorize every wallet/order/profile/admin operation server-side; test user A cannot read or mutate user B's private state.
Rate-limit authentication/abuse boundaries and separate member/admin roles.
Keep test identities isolated and describe handling of a lost account before releasing persistent backing.

issues.title: Create an auditable Credit ledger and exactly-once starting grant
issues.summary: Make the server authoritative for the initial 1,000 Credits, cash/reservations and immutable account events.
acceptance: Grant 1,000 Credits once per eligible account with a unique ledger event; concurrent signup retries cannot duplicate it.
Use integer centi-Credits and transactional balance/reservation invariants; reject negative/overflow/invalid amounts.
Reconcile available Credits, reserved Credits and ledger totals through an admin diagnostic.
No client-editable value or demo balance import can mint Credits; weekly grants remain disabled.

issues.title: Implement server-backed buy reservations and cancellation
issues.summary: Deliver the first full backing vertical slice with pending state visible to the user.
acceptance: Validate member, eligible artist, amount, current snapshot state and idempotency key in a transaction.
Reserve Credits atomically and persist order boundary/price-estimate context; retries return the same order.
Cancel pending buys once, release the reservation and prevent cancellation after settlement wins a race.
Test insufficient funds, double submit, simultaneous buys, ineligible artist and cancel/settle races.

issues.title: Implement queued partial/full exits and quantity reservations
issues.summary: Sales must reserve position quantities, not promise a fixed payout based on the order-time estimate.
acceptance: Queue explicit units/lot allocation using the agreed precision; prevent overlapping sales from overselling.
Support partial and full exits, cancellation and idempotent resubmission.
Show that estimated proceeds may change at execution; release reserved units exactly once on cancellation.
Test fractional lots, rounding, duplicate sale, simultaneous exits and retention of early-support history.

issues.title: Settle eligible orders transactionally at accepted snapshots
issues.summary: Implement the core next-valid-update executor against controlled snapshots first, then integrate the approved data adapter.
acceptance: Apply the versioned cutoff and snapshot eligibility; record execution snapshot, units, cash movements, lots and immutable receipt event atomically.
Execute buys and sells using deterministic precision/cost-basis rules, including partial exits.
Unique settlement keys and durable batches make retries safe; a crash cannot debit without its matching position/event.
Reject stale, disputed, missing or mismatched metrics and apply the agreed freeze/cancel policy.
Test competing workers, replayed batch, old orders, insufficient/invalid snapshot and boundaries around the update cutoff.

issues.title: Connect portfolio and artist backing screens to owned APIs
issues.summary: Replace demo account authority with server reads/mutations while preserving the editorial UI.
acceptance: Show actual available/reserved Credits, positions, pending orders and update eligibility on artist/collection screens.
Handle optimistic/loading/error/retry states without double orders; refresh after settlement and cancellation.
Keep demo mode clearly separate, with no automatic promotion of local Credits/receipts into verified history.
Verify account switching, refresh, multiple tabs/devices and expired sessions cannot leak or corrupt another wallet.

issues.title: Test ledger invariants, authorization and settlement concurrency
issues.summary: Validate the accounting contract using integration tests against real PostgreSQL transactions, not only mocks of the demo engine.
acceptance: Exercise concurrent buys/exits/cancel/settle, repeated signup, worker replay and transaction rollback.
Reconcile all ledger, reservation and position invariants after generated sequences and partial failures.
Cover per-user authorization, invalid units and duplicate idempotency keys with differing payloads.
Add CI database setup, migration and isolation/cleanup; document the precision tolerances and expected vectors.

issues.title: Issue server-verifiable early-support receipts
issues.summary: Turn the cultural early-support screenshot into a verifiable record with a stable URL, without pretending a local card is proof.
acceptance: Create receipts from committed server backing events, with unique IDs and no client-set timestamps or listener values.
Show artist identity, committed/executed/metric-observed times, source snapshot, committed Credits and later exit/correction context.
Provide a verification route and shareable card; unchanged public URL verifies against server history after refresh/device change.
Keep receipt evidence after selling, respect privacy/deletion policy and state what the record actually proves.

issues.title: Define and implement pseudonymous public profiles and sharing
issues.summary: Let members flex early support without forcing their entire wallet or personal identity into public view.
acceptance: Decide public/private defaults and fields, profile handles, selectively shared receipts and block/report entry points.
Validate handles and sanitize display fields; avoid exposing email, session data or private holdings via public APIs.
Explain how hiding/deleting a profile affects shared receipts and audit retention.
Test public, private, signed-out and removed-account views across copied URLs.

issues.title: Persist watchlists and member artist suggestions
issues.summary: Save discovery intent across devices and provide real delivery of requests rather than the demo's local-only form.
acceptance: Watch/unwatch is authorized and idempotent; saved artists persist across sessions and devices.
Suggestions enter C07's review queue and show submitted/duplicate/reviewed states.
Use safe optimistic UI and handle timeouts/offline/retry without duplicates.
Do not import another user's local state automatically or promise requests have been reviewed before they are.

issues.title: Build onboarding and clear freshness/pending-state explanations
issues.summary: A new member should understand artist backing without reading an investment dashboard.
acceptance: Explain virtual nonredeemable Credits, initial allocation, listener-based movement and queued execution in compact contextual UI.
Make available/reserved Credits, pending estimates, observation times, stale/suspended data and losses understandable.
Provide a clear demo versus connected-beta mode boundary and prevent faux community totals.
Test first-use/back/refresh and 320px keyboard-accessible flows with the existing editorial style.

issues.title: Implement privacy, retention, export and account deletion policy
issues.summary: Decide how private identity, public receipts and necessary accounting audit records coexist before collecting real accounts.
acceptance: Document minimum collected data, retention, processing providers and public-profile choices; do not publish private account identifiers.
Provide account data export and a deletion/redaction workflow with defined receipt/audit consequences.
Implement authorization and confirmation for destructive account actions, plus admin access audit.
Review invite-beta terms/community reporting and third-party embed disclosures; record owner decisions before public launch.

issues.title: Provision an isolated self-hosted staging environment
issues.summary: Choose the host/domain/budget with the founder and implement the documented Docker deployment without assuming Vercel or a paid data service.
acceptance: Record selected host, monthly budget, region and domain; no purchase is made without authorization.
Run app, private PostgreSQL and worker with persistent storage, server-only secrets and HTTPS reverse proxy.
Use separate staging/production credentials/data; expose readiness and restart policies.
Deploy a selected commit to staging, exercise direct URLs/health and document update/rollback commands.

issues.title: Test database backups, restore and release recovery
issues.summary: A backup is useful only when the portfolio and support history can be restored consistently.
acceptance: Schedule encrypted off-host backups with selected retention, least-privilege access and failure visibility.
Restore into an isolated environment and reconcile ledger/snapshots/receipts; record measured recovery time and maximum data-loss window.
Document compatible app/schema rollback or forward-fix procedure and simulate a failed deployment.
Verify secrets and private data never enter the public repository or CI artifacts.

issues.title: Add operational visibility and failure controls
issues.summary: Keep collection and settlement failures visible without buying an observability stack prematurely.
acceptance: Provide structured redacted logs and counters for snapshot age, collection success, queue age, failed settlements and ledger reconciliation.
Separate liveness/readiness and show an accurate user-facing last-update/stale state.
Define alert thresholds, operator ownership and runbooks for worker outage, bad data and unavailable DB.
Rehearse an outage and ensure retries/recovery are visible without leaking identities or tokens.

issues.title: Complete invite-beta end-to-end, accessibility and abuse verification
issues.summary: Verify the entire connected product in staging before inviting real members; a file-preview test is insufficient.
acceptance: Run sign-in → starting grant → discovery/playback → queued buy → accepted update → position → partial/full exit → retained verified receipt across devices.
Verify keyboard/focus/dialogs, reduced motion, 320px/mobile and desktop, empty/error/offline states, and supported browser differences.
Exercise authorization, rate limiting, no duplicate grants/orders, admin boundaries, stale sources, failed jobs and private-profile URLs.
Record evidence, version, open defects and release/no-release decision; close critical integrity/privacy issues before invitations.

issues.title: Define first-party beta analytics and the pilot feedback loop
issues.summary: Measure whether discovery and early-support evidence are useful, with minimal data collection.
acceptance: Define activation as a meaningful completed action such as first settled backing; specify D1/D7 return, saves and receipt use with clear denominators.
Agree invite cohort size, success thresholds and review cadence with the founder instead of inventing targets.
Implement a small privacy-aware event vocabulary without third-party tracking by default; keep playback-provider metrics distinct.
Provide a feedback/report channel and weekly findings template; do not recruit or message others automatically.

issues.title: Review media redistribution and select the source-code license
issues.summary: Public source and third-party artwork need distinct rights decisions. Source attribution alone is not permission to redistribute artist images.
acceptance: Review bundled images/source metadata and remove, replace or obtain permission for assets without a suitable redistribution basis before wider release.
Choose and record the owner's intended source-code license; leave code unlicensed until selected rather than inventing an MIT grant.
Check public history for secrets, personal paths and generated tool output; use a separate asset notice where appropriate.
Document embed attribution/provider requirements and ensure sample media does not imply artist endorsement.

issues.title: Design connected daily matchups and global ranking rules
issues.summary: Four fixed disconnected pairs cannot establish a meaningful full ranking of eight songs. Vary assignments across members so the aggregated comparison graph connects all eight.
acceptance: Specify balanced matching/exposure, one eligible vote per assigned pair, rotation identity and deterministic aggregation.
Define ties, minimum votes/graph coverage, low-data fallback, time zone/cutoff and prediction-lock/reveal rules.
Simulate sparse and biased participation and verify the estimator does not present disconnected-pair win rates as an exact global preference order.
Record founder decision and examples; daily participation remains separate from artist backing.

issues.title: Resolve Spotify content use for the public daily mechanic
issues.summary: Spotify Widget Terms IV.2.d require written approval for game functionality using Spotify content. Discovery embeds do not establish approval for the daily game.
acceptance: Record dated official terms and choose an approved/permitted daily design or documented approval before public enablement.
Keep server-enforced release gating while unresolved; never imply approval was received.
Confirm any substitute content/provider actually permits the intended use and recording version; do not silently switch the agreed discovery provider.
No external outreach is sent under this issue unless the founder separately authorizes it.

issues.title: Persist daily rotations, vote assignments and locked predictions
issues.summary: Implement a real daily rotation only after aggregation design and provider-use gates are resolved.
acceptance: Admins publish a versioned eight-track rotation with matching/recording provenance.
Assign and persist balanced pairs, accept authorized idempotent votes and prevent post-cutoff or duplicate submissions.
Persist predictions before results become visible; protect against changing votes/guesses after reveal.
Define account/rate limits and server timestamps; test midnight boundaries, offline retries and rotation changes.

issues.title: Publish community ranking results honestly
issues.summary: Replace the illustrative demo ranking with server aggregates and reproducible scoring.
acceptance: Calculate the agreed estimator and score locked predictions against a fixed published result version.
Display participation/coverage and insufficient-data/tie states without fabricated consensus.
Make reveal timing deterministic and prevent result leakage before prediction lock.
Test disconnected/sparse inputs, late jobs, duplicate votes and a corrected result version.

issues.title: Define and implement credible early-backer badges
issues.summary: Recognition should reward meaningful early support rather than editable screenshots, cancelled reservations or tiny spam positions.
acceptance: Decide minimum committed Credits, entry listener tiers, settlement requirement, calculation version and retention after exit.
Derive awards idempotently from server events; show evidence and criteria on profiles/receipts.
Handle corrected snapshots, deleted profiles and disqualified/abusive accounts with an auditable policy.
Test cancelled orders never qualify and duplicate job execution cannot duplicate awards.

issues.title: Decide and implement recurring Credit top-ups
issues.summary: The weekly top-up concept is desired but amount and eligibility are not yet decided. Keep it off until the founder chooses the economy.
acceptance: Record amount, cap, week boundary, active-account eligibility and anti-multi-account limits with worked examples.
Use a unique account/week ledger event and server scheduling; retries cannot grant twice.
Show grant history and expected eligibility without promising cash value or growth.
Test concurrent workers, eligibility changes, missed week and migration between economy versions.

issues.title: Fill missing beta artist pictures and verify image coverage
issues.summary: Fill the 18 missing artist-profile images, record identity/source evidence, retain an accessible image-error fallback and verify all 50 catalog pictures through the isolated browser suite.
acceptance: Every curated artist has a local, decodable picture and a source mapping.
Record reviewed artist identities; use existing track credits and explicit alias evidence rather than name-only guesses.
Verify catalog images, direct artist routes and the standalone QA preview.
Test a failed image leaves an accessible fallback without hiding a different artist picture.
Run typecheck, unit tests, production/preview builds and isolated desktop/mobile browser checks.

issues.title: Add inspectable monthly-listener history to artist pages
issues.summary: Replace the decorative artist spark line with an inspectable monthly-listener chart. The beta uses clearly generated demo history; C04 will supply real collected observations through the same data interface.
acceptance: Show monthly-listener values, 7/30/90-day range controls and range growth in the editorial app layout.
Support pointer, touch and keyboard inspection with accessible values and descriptions.
Label generated series explicitly as demo history, not Spotify observations.
Preserve actual verified observations and outages; support empty, one-point and invalid-reading states without backfill.
Verify the chart and 320px layout in isolated browser tests without changing backing or recording behavior.
